太丘長 is the office title held by 陳仲弓, referring to him as the magistrate of Taiqiu.
吏 refers to the clerk/official who falsely claimed his mother was ill.
母 refers to the mother of the clerk, mentioned in the false claim about her illness.

records.explanation: 吏 is a collective descriptive reference to officials/subordinates in the context. It refers to the clerk(s) who falsely claimed their mother was ill. This is distinct from 陳仲弓 (the magistrate) and from 主簿 (the registrar).
太丘長 is the office title that 陳仲弓 holds. The text states 陳仲弓為太丘長, so 太丘長 is the office held by 陳仲弓 (sfh1-mention-da5b5728f0f4aa53bd42cf21).
仲弓 is the personal name (字) of 陳寔, used in the main text. It corefers with 寔, 陳, and 陳仲弓, all referring to the same person.

寔 is the personal name of 陳寔 (陳仲弓), appearing in the Liu annotation as an abbreviated reference to the same person as 陳仲弓 in the main text. It corefers with 陳 (surname), 陳仲弓 (full name), and 仲弓 (personal name).
陳 is the surname reference in the Liu annotation, referring to the same person 陳寔 (陳仲弓) as the main text. It corefers with 寔, 陳仲弓, and 仲弓.
母 refers to the mother of the 吏 (the clerk who falsely claimed illness). The text says 吏有詐稱母病, meaning the clerk falsely claimed his mother was ill. The mother is possessed by/related to the clerk.
陳仲弓 is the full name of the protagonist 陳寔. He serves as 太丘長 (office holder). Corefers with 寔, 陳, and 仲弓.

主簿 is an office title referring to the registrar who petitions 陳仲弓 to put the clerk in prison for interrogation. The 主簿 is a distinct person from 陳仲弓, the 吏, and the 母. The 主簿 makes a request (請) to the magistrate.

assertions.interpretation: The event occurs during the period when Chen Zhonggong served as Chief of Taiqiu, establishing the office-holding context for the scene.
A clerk falsely claimed his mother was ill to request leave, which is the initiating event of the scene.
The deception was discovered and the clerk was arrested, occurring after the false claim within the scene's sequence.
Chen ordered the clerk to be executed, following the arrest in the narrative sequence.
The chief clerk requested that the prisoner be sent to prison for interrogation about other crimes, occurring after the execution order.
Chen's quoted statement that no crime is greater than disloyalty and unfilial conduct, forming his rationale.
Chen's quoted rhetorical question asking whether investigating other crimes could surpass this one, concluding the scene.

assertion.interpretation: Chen's quoted reasoning that deceiving the ruler is disloyal and falsely claiming a mother's illness is unfilial, cited as the basis for his judgment.
